text.ms:
1. (1) Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Lembaga Pelabuhan

(Pelabuhan Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan dan Pelabuhan Teluk Victoria) 2024.

(2) Perintah ini mula berkuat kuasa pada 15 November 2024.

Tafsiran

2. Dalam Perintah ini, "Lembaga" ertinya Lembaga Pelabuhan Labuan.

Pindaan Jadual Pertama

3. Akta Lembaga Pelabuhan 1963 dipinda dalam Jadual Pertama dengan

memasukkan selepas butiran "Tanjung Pelepas Port" dan butir-butir yang berhubungan

dengannya butiran dan butir-butir yang berikut:

(1)

Port

(2)

Port Authority

(3)

Date of Establishment

"Federal Territory of

Labuan Port

Victoria Bay Port

Labuan Port Authority

Labuan Port Authority

25 October 2024

25 October 2024".

Pemakaian

4. Kecuali bagi Bahagian VIII Akta, semua peruntukan Akta hendaklah terpakai bagi

Pelabuhan Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan dan Pelabuhan Teluk Victoria.

Pemindahan kuasa, hak, dsb.

5. Segala kuasa, hak, kewajipan, liabiliti dan obligasi yang sebaik sebelum tarikh

permulaan kuat kuasa Perintah ini adalah kuasa, hak, kewajipan, liabiliti dan obligasi

Lembaga Pelabuhan Bintulu sebagaimana yang diperluas kepada Pelabuhan Wilayah

Persekutuan Labuan dan Pelabuhan Teluk Victoria di bawah Perintah Lembaga

Pelabuhan Bintulu (Peluasan Fungsi) 2017 [P.U. (A) 35/2017] hendaklah, pada tarikh

permulaan kuat kuasa Perintah ini, diturunkan kepada Lembaga.

Peletakhakan harta, hak, dsb.

6. Segala harta, hak, kepentingan, obligasi dan liabiliti yang berhubungan dengan

pengurusan atau operasi Pelabuhan Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan dan Pelabuhan Teluk

Victoria oleh Lembaga Pelabuhan Bintulu sebagaimana yang diperluas kepada

Pelabuhan Wilayah Persekutuan Labuan dan Pelabuhan Teluk Victoria di bawah

Perintah Lembaga Pelabuhan Bintulu (Peluasan Fungsi) 2017 hendaklah, pada tarikh

permulaan kuat kuasa Perintah ini, dipindahkan kepada dan terletak hak pada Lembaga

tanpa apa-apa pemindahhakan, penyerahhakan atau pemindahan.

Perjanjian sedia ada

7. Perjanjian sebagaimana yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual yang dibuat sebelum

tarikh permulaan kuat kuasa Perintah ini yang berhubungan dengan harta, hak,

kepentingan, obligasi dan liabiliti yang dipindahkan kepada dan terletak hak pada

Lembaga di bawah perenggan 6 hendaklah, pada tarikh permulaan kuat kuasa Perintah

ini, terus berkuat kuasa terhadap atau memihak kepada Lembaga dan dikuatkuasakan

seolah-olah Lembaga telah dinamakan dalam perjanjian, surat ikatan, surat cara dan

dokumen lain itu.

Penerusan undang-undang

8. Undang-Undang Kecil Lembaga Pelabuhan Labuan (Pelabuhan Teluk Victoria)

(Skala Kadar, Dius dan Caj) 2020 [P.U. (A)108/2020] hendaklah, pada tarikh permulaan

kuat kuasa Perintah ini, terus berkuat kuasa dan disifatkan telah dibuat oleh Lembaga

sehingga dipinda atau dibatalkan.

PORT AUTHORITIES ACT 1963

PORT AUTHORITIES (FEDERAL TERRITORY OF LABUAN PORT

AND VICTORIA BAY PORT) ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 47 of the Port Authorities Act 1963

[Act 488], the Yang di-Pertuan Agong makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Port Authorities (Federal Territory of

Labuan Port and Victoria Bay Port) Order 2024.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 November 2024.

Interpretation

2. In this Order, "Authority" means the Labuan Port Authority.

Amendment of First Schedule

3. The Port Authorities Act 1963 is amended in the First Schedule by inserting

after item "Tanjung Pelepas Port" and the particulars relating to it the following items

and particulars:

(1)

Port

(2)

Port Authority

(3)

Date of Establishment

"Federal Territory of

Labuan Port

Victoria Bay Port

Labuan Port Authority

Labuan Port Authority

25 October 2024

25 October 2024".

Application

4. Except for Part VIII of the Act, all provisions of the Act shall apply

to Federal Territory of Labuan Port and Victoria Bay Port.

Transfer of powers, rights, etc.

5. All powers, rights, duties, liabilities, and obligations which immediately before

the date of coming into operation of this Order were the powers, rights, duties, liabilities

and obligations of the Bintulu Port Authority as extended to the Federal Territory of

Labuan Port and the Victoria Bay Port under the Bintulu Port Authority (Extension of

Functions) Order 2017 [P.U. (A) 35/2017] shall, on the date of coming into operation of

this Order, be devolved upon the Authority.

Vesting of property, rights, etc.

6. All properties, rights, interests, obligations and liabilities relating to

the management or operation of the Federal Territory of Labuan Port and

Victoria Bay Port by the Bintulu Port Authority as extended to the Federal Territory of

Labuan Port and the Victoria Bay Port under the Bintulu Port Authority (Extension of

Functions) Order 2017 shall, on the date of coming into operation of this Order,

be transferred to and vested in the Authority without any conveyance,

assignment or transfer.

Existing agreements

7. The agreements as specified in the Schedule made before the date of coming into

operation of this Order relating to the properties, rights, interests, obligations and

liabilities be transferred to and vested in the Authority under paragraph 6 shall, on the

date of coming into operation of this Order, continue to be in force against or in favour of

the Authority and enforceable as if the Authority has been named on such agreements,

deeds, instruments and other documents.

Continuance of laws

8. The Labuan Port Authority (Victoria Bay Port) (Scale of Rates, Dues and Charges)

By-Laws 2020 [P.U. (A) 108/2020] shall, on the date coming into operation of this Order,

continue to be in force and deemed to be made by the Authority until amended

or revoked.
